title: Stalk of an inverse image, compatible with germs of pulled-back sections
statement:
Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $\bar x=f\circ\bar y$ the image geometric point of $X$. Let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $f^{-1}G$ its inverse image with unit $\eta_{f,G}:G\to f_*f^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], so that for $U\to X$ etale $\eta_{f,G}(U):G(U)\to(f_*f^{-1}G)(U)=(f^{-1}G)(U\times_XY)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Stalks are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There is an isomorphism of abelian groups
$$c_{f,\bar y,G}:(f^{-1}G)_{\bar y}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }G_{\bar x},$$
natural in $G$, such that for every pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$ of $\bar x$ and every $a\in G(U)$, with $(U\times_XY,(\bar u,\bar y))$ the induced pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar y$,
$$c_{f,\bar y,G}\bigl(\text{germ of }\eta_{f,G}(U)(a)\text{ at }(U\times_XY,(\bar u,\bar y))\bigr)=\text{germ of }a\text{ at }(U,\bar u).$$
In particular, for $U=X$ and $a\in G(X)$: $c_{f,\bar y,G}\bigl((\eta_{f,G}(X)(a))_{\bar y}\bigr)=a_{\bar x}$. (The isomorphism of lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar is an isomorphism of the same groups; this statement adds the compatibility with germs, which is what identifies maps built from the unit.)

proof.text: Choose c = AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso AddCommGrpCat f y [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar]. It is already a natural isomorphism in G. Its definition is the composite of the constructed/abstract pullback comparison, the inverse of Point.sheafFiberComapIso, and Point.sheafFiberIso for pointSmallEtaleComapIso f y. This uses the general-site route explicitly cited by Stacks 03Q1 (3), via Sites 05V1.

For G, U and a lift ū, compose the desired equality with c.inv. Expand the three factors of c.inv. Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberIso_inv_app transports the germ to the lift (pointSmallEtaleFiberEtaleIso f y).inv.app U ū. Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app then rewrites it as the unit of the abstract sheaf pullback followed by the germ at that lift and the stalk of the abstract/constructed pullback comparison. These two rewrite lemmas are proved in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.Category and .Comap, respectively; they describe the factors of the isomorphism in the preceding step.

Use Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality to move the pullback comparison before the germ. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, evaluated on U, identifies the abstract unit followed by that comparison with the unit of Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. This proves the required germ equality by associativity. The transported lift agrees definitionally with the lift in the statement. No extra hypothesis on f or on G is used.
